# ccsds_frame_accel

CCSDS frame accelerator (Linux-owned). Applies the CCSDS pseudo-randomizer to each frame streamed through it by axi_dma_frame and computes CRC-16-CCITT over the output bytes. Bit-exact reference: libs/common (satlink_ccsds_randomize_frame, satlink_crc16_ccitt).

- **Address space:** ps
- **Base address:** `0x43C10000` (provisional)
- **Owner:** linux
- **Interrupts (GIC interrupt ID):** frame_done = 67

| `0x04` | CTRL | RW | `0x00000000` | Control bits. |
| `0x08` | STATUS | W1C | `0x00000000` | Sticky event flags; write 1 to clear. |
| `0x0C` | CRC | RO | `0x0000FFFF` | CRC-16-CCITT (init 0xFFFF) of the last output frame. Reads 0x0000 when the frame ends with a valid big-endian FECF. |
